title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:19654:20060824:00012:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 19654, August 24, 2006>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on October 1, 2006.

(2) (Applicability concerning Payment of Members' Allowances) The amended provisions of Article 2 (1) shall apply beginning with allowances payable for October 2006.
